channel.title: Help: Questions Desk (new threads)
channel.description: Threads in the forum category "Help: Questions Desk" - If you've got questions about the sandbox, chat, formatting (wiki syntax/coding), or anything that involves the writing process and/or something you're currently writing, post here.

item.title: would a Chernobyl SCP work?
item.description: would an SCP based on Chernobyl work nowadays?
item.content:encoded: from what I understand SCPs based on real life places is no problem, but usually those places are either undefined beyond a general area or incredibly dangerous. Long story short I was thinking of making making an SCP based on Chernobyl, but from what I've researched Chernobyl has been open to the public for years now, would this make my idea pointless or could it still work?

item.title: Need Help in moving forward in co authoring
item.description: I have an idea I still believed in
item.content:encoded:
Hello,

I have an idea that was greenlit, drafted, posted, and failed. A little disheartened to say the least, but I believe in this idea, think it's something the Foundation could use, and would like to keep moving forward. My main idea is I think I probably need a co author to help, but have no idea how to effectively find one, nor if any of this is even 'ok'.

If anyone could point me in the right direction I'd be thankful.

item.title: Help: New writer who wants to create a canon.
item.content:encoded: Alright, so I'm not exactly new to the SCP community, I've been a lurker for a while but never posted anything. But I have had this idea for a canon, in which a young man discovers that his estranged father is actually the creator/cause of a fair number of anomalies. For example (may or may not appear in future tales/skips) he was annoyed by a coworker and turned him into 106. But the problem is I'm not entirely sure how to make the canon work. I'm much more used to writing non-scp sci fi, so, I guess my main question is. Does it have to be a mix of tales and skips (like pitch-haven) or can it just be tales?

item.title: Is there a canon history of The Foundation?
item.description: Is there like a load of 'facts' like it was founded then or this site does this.
item.content:encoded:
So, is there a list of sites and do they have specialisation?
Like site-19 crops up a lot but why? Is there a list of facilities used by the foundation?
Surely there has to be some common-ground everyone stems from? Eg: 'Site-05 doesn't exist'
Or is it literally just make it sound convincing and no one really cares.
I ask cos I'm thoroughly expecting to write something and then someone goes *pushes glasses up nose* "Well actually.."
I'm sorry if it isn't very clear plz don't hurt me
